archetype: Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) blended with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy), aligned with Airbnb's clean, modern design aesthetic.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Mobile-first layout. Use full viewport height. Maintain generous touch targets and optical alignment.

global_navigation.style: Fixed bottom, bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#EBEBEB] pb-safe pt-2

otp_login.layout: Centered content, massive number input field, sticky bottom CTA button.
otp_login.style: Input field: text-3xl tracking-widest text-center. No side borders, just a thick bottom border that turns #FF385C on focus.

availability_toggle.layout: Prominent sticky header or top card on the Home view.
availability_toggle.style: Neumorphic/Tactile pill toggle. When ON: bg-[#FF385C] text-white shadow-lg. When OFF: bg-[#F3F4F6] text-[#717171].

radius_slider.layout: Card located under the availability toggle.
radius_slider.style: Custom Shadcn Slider (10m to 10km). Track: #EBEBEB, Range: #FF385C, Thumb: White with shadow-md border-2 border-[#FF385C].

user_list_card.layout: Flex row, avatar on left, details in middle, action on right. Padding p-4, bg-white, border-b border-[#EBEBEB].
user_list_card.details: Name (text-lg font-bold), Distance (text-sm text-[#717171] with MapPin icon).
user_list_card.online_indicator: Absolute positioned 12px green (#31A24C) dot with 2px white border on bottom right of avatar.
user_list_card.action_button: Small rounded-full button. 'Send Request' in #FF385C text, bg-white, border border-[#FF385C].

chat_interface.layout: Standard chat bubbles. Sender: bg-[#FF385C] text-white rounded-br-none. Receiver: bg-[#F3F4F6] text-[#222222] rounded-bl-none.
chat_interface.input: Fixed bottom input area, rounded-full bg-[#F3F4F6] with send icon button inside.

image_urls.description: Cork world map pieces, minimalist geometry for login/onboarding background
Two colleagues with headsets for Support/Contact page header

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize standard mobile-first layout using JavaScript (.js or .jsx) files.
Wrap everything in a `max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative bg-white` container if viewed on desktop, simulating a mobile device.
Use Lucide-React for all icons (MapPin, User, MessageCircle, Settings, ToggleLeft/Right, Slider).
Do NOT use pure #000000 for text; use the defined #222222.
For the Map View (optional), use a simple grey placeholder block or a stylized static map image, unless integrating a real map library like react-map-gl.
Ensure the 'availability toggle' is highly visible and uses the primary Coral color when active.
Build the UI without heavy Shadcn 'Card' wrappers. Use raw div with bg-white border-b for list items to keep the clean Airbnb list style.
